Usage: resecta-data validate-schemas [OPTIONS]

  Validate every build artifact against its routed schema.

  Artifacts without a routing entry in SCHEMA_ROUTES are skipped with a warning. Binary artifacts
  (e.g., .bloom) are always skipped.

Options:
  --build-dir DIRECTORY    Directory containing generated artifacts.  [required]
  --schemas-dir DIRECTORY  Directory containing *.schema.json files.  [required]
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
